fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole bass boat on its trailer in the boats-by-owner section.
findings: Four of the five photos are dealer showroom shots of a new boat, per the seller's own text, so they don't show this boat
The one photo of the seller's boat in the driveway shows glossy red metalflake paint along the port side with no visible oxidation or dullness
Consoles and seats in the driveway photo look clean and bright from that distance
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Vexus AVX. From the driveway photo it already looks sharp, with the red finish on the port side still glossy. If you'd like it spotless for showings, we offer a pre-sale wash, wax and interior wipe-down that comes to you. Would you like a quote?
